data.one_liner: A simple flutter widget to paint with your fingers, supporting colors, undo, and export to PNG.
data.what_it_does: A simple flutter widget to paint with your fingers. It supports setting a background color, undo, and export to png.
use_when: You need a basic drawing canvas widget in your app.
Users need to draw with their fingers and export the drawing as a PNG.
avoid_when: You need advanced image editing or multi-layer graphics software.
You need complex vector path manipulation.
strengths: Allows checking if anything was drawn using PainterController.isEmpty
weaknesses: After calling finish() on a PainterController you can't draw on this painting any more
Limited feature set beyond basic finger painting
data.minimal_example:
